step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram shows an ingestion and document processing pipeline for e-learning content generation:
1. End users upload PDF files, which are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket.
2. S3 sends events to Amazon EventBridge.
3. EventBridge triggers AWS Step Functions (which orchestrates AWS Lambda functions).
4. AWS Lambda invokes an Amazon SageMaker real-time endpoint to analyze page images with a custom ML model.
5. Step Functions calls Amazon Textract for text extraction and semantic post-processing.
6. Step Functions emits a completion event back to Amazon EventBridge.

edges.notes: End users upload raw PDF files to S3 bucket.
S3 triggers an event on EventBridge main bus upon file upload.
EventBridge triggers Step Functions workflow execution.
Step Functions executes Lambda functions to process pages.
Lambda sends converted page images to SageMaker real-time endpoint.
SageMaker returns image classification and analysis results back to Lambda.
Step Functions invokes Managed Textract API for text extraction.
Textract returns extracted text for semantic and reading-order analysis.
Step Functions publishes event back to EventBridge notifying completion.
